methods.label: Equal bases and a common height
methods.explanation: The two triangles have equal bases (\(BD=CD\)) and the same height (both are the distance from \(A\) to \(BC\)), so their areas are equal.
methods.levelReason: The method combines the Grade 8 median definition with the elementary triangle area formula and perpendicular height.
